newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen says has US$247 mln in 1997 deals.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says has US$247 mln in 1997 deals.

text.p: Funeral home operator the Loewen Group Inc said Wednesday that it has already signed agreements for US$247 million in acquisitions to close early in 1997.
The deals are for 60 funeral homes and 86 cemeteries.
Loewen repeated that it had a record number of acquisitions in 1996 including US$1.4 billion in signed, closed or structured acquisitions.
Loewen said its long-term growth strategy was the key to its successful defense against a hostile bid by Service Corp International which withdrew its US$2.9 billion offer on Tuesday.
Loewen said it closed US$583 million on acquisitions in 1996, up from US$488 million in 1995. It doubled its purchases of cemeteries in 1996, closing 136 deals.

The 1996 acquisitions include US$287 million in smaller, family-owned funeral homes and cemeteries, primarily in rural areas. This was up from US$166 million. Analysts closely watch the company's acquisitions in this area because they usually produce the highest return on investment.
